currentCard.explanation: T-лимфоциты созревают в тимусе. Их незрелые предшественники (тимоциты) переходят туда из костного мозга и проходят дальнейшее развитие.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: Anatomy of the Lymphatic and Immune Systems

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L74 distinguishes B-cell maturation in red marrow from T-cell maturation in thymus; L75 and L105 explicitly describe migration from marrow and maturation in thymus. Marrow is the origin/early development site, whereas nodes and spleen are secondary organs where mature lymphocytes mount responses (L126/L133-L134/L143-L149). All four labels are real lymphoid organ sites with plausible roles in T-cell biology. Only thymus supplies the requested standard maturation organ; independent nominative labels consistently answer «В каком органе…?».

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: T-лимфоциты созревают в тимусе. Их незрелые предшественники (тимоциты) переходят туда из костного мозга и проходят дальнейшее развитие.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Sentence1 directly gives thymus as the T-cell maturation site (L74-L75). Sentence2 follows L105, which calls the immature T cell a thymocyte, leaving marrow and maturing largely in thymus. This preserves the distinction between initial development in marrow and subsequent maturation. Two complete sentences, no assertion that every immune cell matures in thymus.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Из гемопоэтических стволовых клеток здесь развиваются клетки крови; незрелые T-клетки затем переходят в тимус.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L68 states blood/immune cells arise from hematopoietic stem cells in marrow. L74-L75 and L105 say initially developed immature T cells migrate to thymus. The note teaches the marrow origin and correct transition, without claiming marrow is the principal T-maturation organ.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Тимус расположен над сердцем; сюда из костного мозга мигрируют незрелые T-клетки для дальнейшего созревания.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L110 caption explicitly states thymus lies above the heart; L109 gives its sternum/aorta location. L75/L105 state that immature T cells migrate there from marrow for further maturation. Above-heart location is a concrete thymus-specific extra fact beyond prompt/key, not just repetition of T maturation. The wording relies on the textual caption and prose, not unseen image pixels.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Лимфатические узлы фильтруют лимфу и служат местом адаптивных иммунных ответов с участием T- и B-клеток.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L133 calls lymph nodes filters removing debris/pathogens from lymph. L134 explicitly assigns them adaptive responses mediated by T and B cells. This is a true node-specific function; L126 distinguishes those responses by mature cells from primary-organ maturation.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Селезёнка удаляет микробы из крови и служит местом иммунных ответов на патогены, попавшие в кровь.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L144 states spleen removes microbes/material from blood and is a location of immune responses to blood-borne pathogens; L149 distinguishes red-pulp filtering and white-pulp adaptive responses. Both clauses describe this option’s actual function, not thymic maturation.

absoluteLevel.assessment: Distinguishing the T-cell maturation organ from marrow origin/B maturation and secondary lymphoid response sites requires familiarity with basic immunology. All four are related plausible organs, so everyday adult knowledge or answer grammar does not determine the key. This is thematic introductory biology rather than a rare professional detail or a hard multistep deduction.
